podcast.title: Early Jazz Fanatic
podcast.body: John Steele met Eric Burden at art school in Newcastle, sharing a fanaticism for jazz that led them to form a trad jazz band. "Steel and burden, when they met at art school, were both jazz fanatics, and they quickly formed a trad jazz band."

podcast.title: Post-Animals Career
podcast.body: After leaving The Animals due to financial frustrations, John Steele worked in a shop. He later reformed a version of The Animals in the 1990s and now tours the UK as The Animals and Friends, with Mick Gallagher on keyboards. "John Steel left the group tired of not getting any money, and went to work in a shop."

podcast.title: Shift to Drums
podcast.body: As the band transitioned from trad jazz to rock and roll/skiffle, John Steele moved from playing trombone to drums. "Steel shifted to drums"
